research_findings: Identified a 'Cannot access refs during render' React linter error in 'src/components/landing/AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx'.
The error was caused by accessing the 'preferReducedMotion.current' ref value directly in the render logic to determine animation states.
features_improved: Refactored 'AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx' to use a 'useState' hook for 'preferReducedMotion' instead of a 'useRef'.
Added tests in 'src/components/landing/__tests__/AdaptiveCoachDemo.test.tsx' to ensure 'window.matchMedia' reduced-motion preference does not crash the component and works correctly.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate test failures in 'DiagramCanvas.test.tsx' related to missing 'act(...)' wrappers for React state updates.
